description: Source code for a parser and writer for serialization data in the Wesnoth game, including parsing logic, error handling, and serialization output functions.

classes.name: parser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing serialization data from an input stream into a configuration object.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Main parsing function that processes tokens and builds the configuration structure.

methods.name: parse_element
methods.description: Parses an element (tag) in the serialization data.

methods.name: parse_variable
methods.description: Parses a variable assignment within an element.

methods.name: lineno_string
methods.description: Generates a string describing the line number and file for error reporting.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Handles parsing errors by throwing exceptions with detailed messages.
